fx_policy: All portfolio values and issuer revenue are USD. No local-currency conversion applied. USD-reported global revenue contains company translation effects, included in the revenue denominator effect rather than separately attributed.
time_policy: Retrospective data-vintage comparison, not a point-in-time backtest. Historical fiscal figures and later restatements were retrieved in 2026. Fiscal year-end alignment is enforced per issuer, not falsely treated as identical across issuers.
scope12_basis: Reported operational Scope 1+market-based Scope 2; no offset subtraction
scope3_basis: Separately reported gross issuer totals under stated issuer methods. Not uniformly GHG Protocol-comparable; missing IBM remains null.

open_material_issues.gap: Historical market equity and all capital components are not verified for four issuers. Financed totals cover only Meta; complete portfolio totals remain null.
open_material_issues.resolution: Retrieve dated raw closing prices and outstanding shares/all equity classes, full liabilities/minority/preferred components; preserve price/share dates and reconstruct EVIC without cash netting.

open_material_issues.gap: IBM Scope 3 for FY2023/FY2024 unavailable in reviewed table; Meta changes criteria in FY2024. Other issuer category boundaries/estimation methods differ.
open_material_issues.resolution: Obtain company category-level GHG Protocol series and restatements. Reconcile exclusions; do not label the heterogeneous observed statistic a comparable portfolio Scope 3 footprint.

open_material_issues.gap: Operational-control emissions and consolidated financial revenue have acquisition/timing differences; Cisco explicitly adds Splunk emissions in FY2025.
open_material_issues.resolution: Obtain like-for-like acquired-entity emissions and revenue bridge before making a fully aligned issuer comparison.

open_material_issues.gap: Mesa water withdrawal is reported but facility hazard, permit headroom, cooling capacity, outage probabilities, margins and avoided losses are not verified.
open_material_issues.resolution: Verify basin/local utility constraints and site operating metrics, then underwrite scenarios without adding gross potential avoided revenue to reported earnings.

open_material_issues.gap: No independent accountable human review or research approval is recorded.
open_material_issues.resolution: Reviewer checks source entailment, component assumptions and open issues in a new approved research workflow; publication alone grants no approval.
